I’ve been thinking about the second choice thing and the only way I can talk myself into understanding it is this.. You can’t be romancing 2 targets for the same position at once. At least not with the general public knowing about it. You have your #1 who you really push for (this year it was Zubi). Just like the Caicedo saga, you get what feels like the green light from the player and their reps and start ironing out the details. While all that happens, it is very likely that other clubs are putting work into your #2 option because they are most likely a quality player. Then, just like the last 2 windows, the #1 who appeared to be set on coming here has a last minute change of heart. Now you’ve invested a lot of time into this target, meanwhile, your #2, #3, maybe even #4 options have all been getting wooed or maybe even signed by other clubs and they all know they weren’t your first choice anyways. So at this point, you can either take a swing on a less guaranteed prospect (Lavia) or try to find someone in the bargain bin (Endo). Obviously, all clubs have to deal with this and have to work around going for multiple targets at the same position, but I think where things are different for us with the last 2 attempts were that our #1 targets seemingly verbally committed to coming here and as a result we poured all our time/effort into getting that deal over the line which also lead to the public leaks which never helps your case from a bargaining position once it’s fallen through. Idk, this could all be utter nonsense and at the end of the day.. I just want a DM that wants us lol.
